title: Rule Feed
description: Generic contract for a single regulation's structured content. The app is written against this schema only — it never has regulation-specific logic.

feed_id.description: Must match the feed's folder name / manifest.feed_id.

clauseList.description: Ordered decomposition of this node's text (in one language) into typed segments, for the long-sentence visual-cue rendering. Concatenating all 'text' fields in order must reconstruct the full text exactly. clauses_ja and clauses_en are independent segmentations of the same meaning — they don't need the same number of entries (English often reorders/merges clauses relative to Japanese), but their clause_type sequence should tell the same structural story.

id.description: Stable, hierarchical, human-legible ID, e.g. 'fsa-basel-cap-jp.ch2.art10.p1'. Never reused or renumbered once published — cross-refs point at this.

number.description: Display label exactly as printed in source, e.g. '第十条', '２', '一'.

heading.description: 見出し — title text attached to this node, if any (common on articles).

heading_en.description: English translation of heading. Numbers are NOT translated here — the app derives 'Article 3' from the Japanese '第三条' deterministically, since that's just numeral conversion, not translation. This field is only for the title text itself.

text_ja.description: Verbatim source text for this node only (not children). Null for purely structural nodes (e.g. a chapter that has no text of its own, only child articles).

summary_ja.description: One-line plain-language summary, generated after all of this node's children are known (e.g. after an article's paragraphs are ingested). Not the same as text_ja — this is a gloss, not a quote.

refs.description: Citations found in text_ja. target_id/target_feed are filled in by ingest.py, not the chatbot.

raw_text.description: Verbatim citation phrase as it appears in text_ja, e.g. '前条第二項', '第十条第一号'. Must be found somewhere in text_ja, including inside parenthetical asides — do not skip a citation just because it's inside kakko.

text_en.description: The corresponding citation phrase as it appears in text_en, e.g. 'Article 52-23, paragraph (1) of the Banking Act'. Used to link the same reference in the English rendering.

scope.description: internal = same feed/document. external = another law/notification/standard.

external_name.description: Required when scope=external — the name of the other law/notification as written, e.g. '銀行法'.

external_name_en.description: English name of the external law, looked up from feeds/_shared/external_refs.json by ingest.py — a name lookup, not a summary, since the same law name is reused across every feed that cites it.

external_item_summary_ja.description: One-line description of what THIS SPECIFIC cited provision (the exact article/paragraph/item in raw_text) says or covers — not a description of the external law as a whole. Produced by the chatbot per-citation, since it depends on the exact numbers cited. Often derivable with high confidence directly from the citing sentence itself (Japanese legal drafting frequently glosses a citation inline, e.g. '...という' or '...をいう' right next to it) — in that case this is just a restatement of the source text, not external knowledge. See external_item_summary_confidence.

external_item_summary_confidence.description: 'stated_in_text' = the citing sentence itself explains what the cited provision means. 'general_knowledge' = an unverified best guess made without reading the external law's actual text — flag it as such in the UI. 'verified_from_source' = the external law's actual text has been fetched and digitized (see target_feed/target_ids), so this summary is grounded in a real, checkable source, not a guess.

target_ids.description: Resolved node id(s). Usually one; e.g. '前二項' (the preceding two paragraphs) resolves to two. Empty until ingest.py resolves it.

target_feed.description: Resolved feed_id if the target lives outside this feed. Null if not yet linked or unavailable.

resolution_status.description: internal_unavailable = the citation was understood (points at a real article/paragraph of THIS document, e.g. by number) but that target isn't in the currently-loaded content (e.g. a later chapter not yet digitized) — distinct from a citation that couldn't be parsed at all.

expands_to_ja.description: Set ONLY when this term is a shorthand for a longer Japanese phrase named earlier in the same sentence (e.g. 「連結財務諸表規則」 standing in for the ordinance's full name) — the full phrase, in Japanese. Null for a term that's simply being coined/glossed, not abbreviating something. Deliberately separate from term_en: that's an English translation and must never be used as a stand-in for this field — mixing them up means English text leaks into places (like external_name resolution) that expect Japanese.

definition_node_id.description: Node id where this term is defined (usually this node itself).
